Name: Crypto Trader
Author: Arizonapradana
TagLine: Trade cryptocurrencies using in-game gold! Features 10+ cryptos (BTC, ETH, ADA, etc.) !
Description:
🚀 Crypto Trader - Real Cryptocurrency Trading in Stardew Valley

Transform your farming profits into cryptocurrency investments! Crypto Trader brings real-world cryptocurrency trading directly into Stardew Valley with live market prices, professional trading interface, and comprehensive portfolio management.

✨ Core Features
🪙 Multi-Cryptocurrency Support

Trade 10+ popular cryptocurrencies: Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Cardano (ADA), Polkadot (DOT), Stellar (XLM), Chainlink (LINK), Litecoin (LTC), Bitcoin Cash (BCH), Ripple (XRP), Binance Coin (BNB)

Add any cryptocurrency dynamically by typing the symbol (automatically adds USDT pairs)

💰 Professional Trading System

Simple conversion rate: 1 in-game gold = $0.01 USD

Dual input modes: Trade by cryptocurrency amount OR by gold amount

Instant execution: Buy and sell with real-time price calculations

Cost estimation: See exact gold costs before executing trades

Accessible anywhere: Press Insert key to open trading interface from any location

📊 Advanced Portfolio Management

Individual crypto tracking: Holdings, investments, and profit/loss per cryptocurrency

Portfolio overview dashboard: Total value, invested amount, and overall performance

Real-time analytics: Percentage gains/losses with color-coded indicators

Transaction history: Complete record of all trades with timestamps

Performance metrics: Track your most profitable cryptocurrencies

🎮 How to Use
Getting Started

Install the mod and launch Stardew Valley with SMAPI

Press the Insert key anywhere in the game (farm, town, mines, anywhere!)

The professional trading interface opens instantly

Start trading immediately with real market prices

Trading Cryptocurrencies

Add new cryptocurrencies: Type symbol in "Add Symbol" box and click ADD

Switch input modes: Toggle between "Crypto Mode" and "Gold Mode"

Execute trades: Enter amount and click BUY or SELL

View portfolio: Click "Portfolio" button for complete holdings overview

Refresh prices: Manual refresh button or automatic updates every 5 seconds

Portfolio Management

Portfolio View: See all cryptocurrency holdings at a glance

Trading View: Focus on individual cryptocurrency with detailed charts

Performance tracking: Monitor profit/loss for each cryptocurrency

Total portfolio value: Real-time calculation of entire crypto portfolio worth

🎁 Installation & Support
Installation

Download the mod files

Extract to your Stardew Valley Mods folder

Launch the game through SMAPI

Press Insert in-game to start trading!

Troubleshooting

Prices not updating: Check internet connection or wait for automatic retry

Interface won't open: Ensure you're not in a menu/dialogue, press Insert when player is free

Trading errors: Verify sufficient gold balance and valid input amounts

Symbol issues: Ensure cryptocurrency exists on Binance (case-sensitive)
